categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Touches CMakeLists.txt and contrib/guix build scripts with the 'Build system' label.
categories.rationale: Silences Apple linker warnings about duplicate libraries and aligns macOS Guix builds with other targets by treating linker warnings as fatal errors. The change removes noisy build output and improves build consistency across platforms, but addresses no build failures or release-blocking defects.
